_comment: How this skill outputs results. mode=new-sheet-in-folder creates one new Google Sheet per run inside the shared Drive folder below (via create_file with contentMimeType text/csv, which converts to a native Sheet). Note: CometChat's Google Workspace blocks anonymous Apps Script web apps, so in-place append to a single sheet is not possible — each run gets its own dated sheet in the folder instead. If create_file is unavailable, fall back to a local prospects.csv.
